observations: Photo 0: Front view of an orange and black scooter-style motorcycle with plastic wrap on mirrors and front fender. The front panel has 'BAR GO' written on it, and a red flame logo is visible below. The headlight is clear, and the front tire appears to be in decent condition.

Photo 1: Right side view of the motorcycle. It has a black and red mesh seat cover, orange and black body panels, a visible engine, and a black exhaust. The rear tire shows some wear. The rear fender is white. The front wheel has a red rim accent. The motorcycle is on a kickstand on a dirt ground.

Photo 2: Left side view, similar to photo 1. The same features are visible: mesh seat cover, orange and black body, red-rimmed wheels, and plastic wrap on the front. The background shows other motorcycles and a building, suggesting a market or parking area.

All photos show the motorcycle with plastic wrap on parts, suggesting it is new or recently purchased. The ground is unpaved and dusty. The motorcycle appears to be a scooter or underbone type, not a full-size motorcycle.

claims.claim: Clean motorcycle for sale, in good condition, nothing to fix, na buy and drive.
claims.evidence: Photos show no visible damage or major wear, but no proof of mechanical condition, engine function, or recent service. The plastic wrap suggests newness, but not proof of working order.

risks.risk: Engine or mechanical failure (e.g., non-working, poor compression, oil leaks, electrical issues).
risks.proof: Video of the motorcycle starting, idling, and accelerating, or a close-up of the engine and oil level.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with major mechanical issues

risks.risk: Frame or structural damage not visible in photos (e.g., bent frame, rust, or prior accident).
risks.proof: Close-up of the frame, especially near the engine and swingarm, and underside of the motorcycle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged or with hidden structural issues

risks.risk: Tire condition and tread depth (photos show some wear, but not depth).
risks.proof: Close-up of tire treads on both front and rear wheels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as tires needing replacement or with reduced lifespan

risks.risk: Brakes and brake pads (no visible inspection of brake discs or pads).
risks.proof: Close-up of front and rear brake discs and pads.
risks.if_unproven: priced as brakes needing service or replacement

risks.risk: Battery or electrical system (no indication of lights, horn, or charging system).
risks.proof: Video of headlights, taillight, horn, and dashboard lights functioning.
risks.if_unproven: priced as electrical system possibly faulty

proof_requests: Video of the motorcycle starting, idling, and accelerating.
Close-up photos of the engine, oil level, and frame.
Close-up of front and rear tire treads.
Close-up of front and rear brake discs and pads.
Video of headlights, taillight, and horn working.
response.reason: The motorcycle appears clean and new with plastic wrap, but there is no proof of mechanical functionality or hidden damage. Without proof of engine, brakes, tires, and electrical systems, it cannot be priced at its worst case. The brand and model are not readable, so identity is by type only.
